find: const rows = all.filter( ( r ) => inScope( r.rowType ) );
why: only the named sections are checked and marked

find: const review = ( intake.review || [] ).filter( ( r ) => ! inScope( r.rowType ) );
why: every other row keeps its review entry

find: const inScope = ( t ) => ! sections || sections.includes( t );
why: the scope is the named sections

find: review: sections ? review.sort( ( a, b ) => at( a ) - at( b ) ) : review
why: the review keeps its row order
